name: mp-web
description: Mypaisaa Prediction web app: a static SvelteKit PWA built on Prism (MP-134). Local and synthetic only.

scripts.build: npm run assets && vite build && node scripts/check-build.mjs
scripts.check: svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --fail-on-warnings && tsc -p src/service-worker --noEmit && node scripts/prism-components.mjs --check
